sources.note: The Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation's own page for the 2027 scholarship competition, stating the important dates.
The Foundation's eligibility criteria page for the PhD Scholarship: field of study, who can apply, stage of study, key dates.
The Foundation's PhD Scholarships Programme page, listing the benefits of the scholarship.

awarding_body.detail: All three pages are on the awarding body's own domain (trudeaufoundation.ca) and the site footer identifies the operator as the Fondation Pierre Elliott Trudeau. The recorded official URL is the Foundation's own 2027 competition page.

deadline.detail: The 2027 competition is open today (12 October 2026). The recorded exact date, November 6, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET for the complete application, matches the Foundation's page verbatim, as do both earlier sub-deadlines (October 2, 2026 to request eligibility confirmation; October 30, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET for receipt of all three references). The eligibility page adds that the application period runs September 1 to November 6, 2026.
deadline.quote: OCTOBER 2, 2026 Deadline to request eligibility confirmation / WEEKS OF OCTOBER 5 AND OCTOBER 12 Mandatory information sessions / OCTOBER 30, 2026, AT 9:00 A.M. ET Deadline for receipt of all three references / NOVEMBER 6, 2026, AT 5:00 P.M. ET Deadline to submit the complete application

eligibility.detail: Every distinct claim in the record is confirmed on the become-a-scholar page: first or second year of a PhD at time of application; field broadly related to the humanities or social sciences; research aligned with at least one of the four themes; and the three enrolment routes (Canadian student at a Canadian university; Canadian student at a university outside Canada; international student at a Canadian university). The page adds that international students residing outside Canada or enrolled at a university outside Canada are not eligible.
eligibility.quote: Your field of study must be broadly related to the humanities or social sciences and address issues that are relevant to Canada's future. Your PhD research must align with at least one of the Foundation's four themes ... A Canadian student enrolled at a Canadian university; A Canadian student enrolled at a university outside Canada; or An international student enrolled at a Canadian university. International students residing outside Canada or enrolled at a university outside Canada are not eligible. ... At the time of application, you must be: in the first year of a PhD program; or in the second year of a PhD program.

funding.detail: The record's 'Stipend' funding type is accurate: this is a stipend award, not tuition-only and not claimed as fully funded. The scholarship page states what it covers: up to $50,000 per year for three years plus up to $20,000 per year for research and travel, alongside mentorship, an engaged multidisciplinary community and an alumni network.
funding.quote: As a Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Scholar, you will receive: Up to $50,000 per year for three years Up to $20,000 per year for research and travel Mentorship and experiential learning An engaged multidisciplinary community A network of more than 500 alumni

degree_levels.detail: The programme is a PhD scholarship only. The scholarship page is headed 'PHD SCHOLARSHIPS PROGRAM' and states it is designed for doctoral students; the 2027 applications page likewise limits applications to doctoral students in their first or second PhD year.
degree_levels.quote: The Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation PhD Scholarship is designed for doctoral students who want to go beyond academia, grow through mentorship, and contribute to major societal issues through their research.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: November 6, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET (deadline to submit the complete application); October 2, 2026 (deadline to request eligibility confirmation); October 30, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET (deadline for receipt of all three references). Mandatory information sessions in the weeks of October 5 and October 12; the application period runs September 1 to November 6, 2026.
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Re-verified 12 Oct 2026 against the Foundation's own pages; the 2027 cycle is open (complete-application deadline 6 Nov 2026). trudeaufoundation.ca sits behind a bot-protection interstitial that returns 'One moment, please...' to plain HTTP fetchers, so re-check with a real browser; the French sibling page is https://www.fondationtrudeau.ca/candidatures-2027/. Funding is a stipend (up to $50,000/year for three years plus up to $20,000/year for research and travel), not tuition-only. 2027 competition contact address published on the page: scholarship2027@trudeaufoundation.ca.
